description: This file defines an abstract class SynthUnit used in a MIDI synthesizer project. It provides a static method to convert MIDI pitch to frequency and declares an abstract render method for subclasses.

classes.name: SynthUnit
classes.description: Abstract base class for a synthesizer unit enabling pitch-to-frequency conversion and requiring subclasses to implement rendering of sound.

methods.name: pitchToFrequency
methods.description: Converts a MIDI pitch in semitones to its corresponding frequency in Hz.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to render sound; must be implemented by subclasses.
